predictions.reasoning: A sharp jump in the implied probability of Trump resigning would signal an acute US political/governance shock (scandal, health crisis, or forced transition). Sudden leadership uncertainty at the top of the executive raises the equity risk premium and typically triggers a risk-off move in broad US equities. SPY is the most liquid proxy for that beta. However, markets often treat an orderly VP succession (Vance) as policy-continuity, which caps downside, and the base rate of actual resignation is very low.

predictions.reasoning: Acute US political instability and leadership-transition uncertainty is a classic safe-haven catalyst. Gold typically bids on flight-to-safety when US governance risk rises, independent of the equity direction. GLD is a liquid proxy. The signal is weaker than for equities because gold also responds to rates/USD, and an orderly succession would mute the haven bid.

evidence_used: Market question implies resignation probability can spike on political/health/legal shock
Historical equity risk-off and gold haven behavior during acute US governance uncertainty
Polymarket as a noisy early sensor for political events
Liquidity considerations favoring SPY and GLD as broad proxies
uncertainty_notes: Base rate of an actual Trump resignation is very low; most probability spikes will be noise or speculation
Orderly VP succession (continuity) could blunt or reverse any equity selloff
12h window makes reaching the 700bps tradable threshold unlikely absent a confirmed, dramatic catalyst
Proxy exposure is indirect — SPY and GLD respond to many macro drivers simultaneously

llm_justification.summary: A sharp rise in the implied probability of Trump resigning would most plausibly signal an acute US executive-governance shock, driving a risk-off repricing: broad US equities (SPY) lower and safe havens (gold/GLD) higher. Both mappings are directionally sensible but weak in magnitude and confidence given the very low base rate, the mitigating effect of orderly VP succession, and the short 12h window. Expected moves fall below the 700bps tradable threshold in the central case, so this is a low-conviction, monitor-only signal rather than an actionable one.
key_assumptions: A probability spike reflects a genuine new information shock rather than thin-market noise
Markets interpret potential resignation as destabilizing rather than cleanly continuity-preserving
SPY and GLD retain their typical risk-off/haven behavior during political stress
failure_modes: The probability move is pure speculation/noise with no underlying public catalyst, so assets do not move
The event is already public and priced, leaving no residual move
Succession-continuity framing produces a muted or even positive equity reaction (removal of uncertainty)
Gold move is dominated by rates/USD and fails to confirm the haven thesis
Magnitude falls far short of the 700bps tradable bar, making the signal non-actionable
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
